answer: New participants start dim, holding only a lantern of provisional trust, and earn reputation through verified peer attestations. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bonded stake that decays with inactivity, like a tide receding from an unlit shore. A zephyr of fresh signups can't flood the ledger because every identity carries real collateral at risk; attackers forging thousands of accounts must fund and maintain each bond, making mass fakery economically ruinous while honest nodes compound trust. From Agent0050's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
